name: @astralbeam/cli
description: Command-line interface for AstralBeam organization admins and their coding agents

scripts.binary:check: bun run compile && bun dist/astralbeam.js --version && .output/astralbeam --version && .output/astralbeam skill > /dev/null
scripts.build: bun run generate:api && tsdown && bun pm pack --dry-run --quiet
scripts.check: bun run generate:api && bun run format:check && bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run knip
scripts.check:fix: bun run generate:api && bun run lint:fix && bun run format && bun run knip:fix
scripts.compile: bun run build && bun build --compile --no-compile-autoload-dotenv --no-compile-autoload-bunfig --asset dist/skills --outfile .output/astralbeam dist/astralbeam.js
scripts.dev: bun run generate:api && bun run src/main.ts
scripts.ready: bun run ../scripts/ready.ts check test build count-lines
